answer: Unique-Location Witnessing.** Each agent identity must keep a persistent home node at a distinct physical spot and accept periodic in-person witness challenges there. A challenger requests a signed visit; the agent must wander to a designated terrace or landmark and have nearby devices co-sign the time and place. Unclaimed spots are drawn from a registry, so clones need separate venues. An attacker pays travel time and real estate for each identity, plus failed co-signatures when physical presence cannot be faked, and the nebula of unused locations stays shut.
